snippet.title: Riding Star 2 (Part 2) (Horse Game)
snippet.description:
Riding Star 2 / Championship Riding Star is a fantastic horse riding video game. Feel the magic, balance and rhythm of riding in this highly realistic 3D riding simulation game. Enjoy the thrill of competition in the ring and on the track! Players will get to choose from several exciting categories of competitive riding including dressage, jumping and much more!

Check out the complete game here : http://bit.ly/2GUvW5e

TSM Channel on Facebook : https://fb.me/tsmchannel
TSM Channel on STEAM : http://steamcommunity.com/groups/tsmchannel
TSM Channel on Twitch : https://www.twitch.tv/tsmchannel
TSM Channel on Blogger : http://tsmchannel.blogspot.com
